name: search_medications
title: Search medications
description: Search public drug sources and the loaded catalog by generic name or brand. Existing categories and demo configurations remain available in hybrid mode. The visible results update with the same matches. Use returned IDs for details or contextual comparison.

limit.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 5. The visible page still shows every match.

query.description: Catalog search text, such as atorvastatin or cholesterol.

strength.description: Optional exact displayed strength filter, such as 20 mg.

name: get_medication_details
title: Get medication details
description: Read catalog forms, strengths, demo quantities, source status, and SKU count for one medicationId. Public-only prescription status is unknown. Use compare_medications for complete paged public sections.

medicationId.description: ClearDose medication ID returned by search_medications.

name: compare_fulfillment_options
title: Compare exact fulfillment options
description: Compare current pharmacy, delivery, arrival, and total price for one exact SKU. Supply medicationId, form, strength, and quantity together for a new comparison, or omit all four to recompare the current selection.

maxDeliveryDays.description: Optional maximum estimated delivery days. Use 0 to require pickup today.

maxResults.description: Maximum ranked options to return. Defaults to 5 and never changes the visible comparison.

medicationId.description: ClearDose medication ID returned by search_medications.

strength.description: Exact displayed strength, including its unit, such as 20 mg.

name: select_medication_option
title: Select a fulfillment option
description: Select one exact offer and its delivery method in the shared ClearDose selection state. Use IDs returned by compare_fulfillment_options.

deliveryOptionId.description: Delivery option ID attached to the selected offer.

offerId.description: Exact offer ID returned by compare_fulfillment_options.

name: create_prescription_request_card
title: Prepare a prescription request card
description: Prepare and display a local request card for one offerId and deliveryOptionId from compare_fulfillment_options. The tool derives the exact SKU and never issues or transmits a prescription.

dateOfBirth.description: Optional demo date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format.

deliveryOptionId.description: Delivery option ID attached to the selected offer.

offerId.description: Exact offer ID returned by compare_fulfillment_options.

name: add_to_cart
title: Add medication to cart
description: Add one offerId and deliveryOptionId from compare_fulfillment_options to the local demo cart. Use this after the user chooses an option. The visible cart opens and updates.

deliveryOptionId.description: Delivery option ID attached to the selected offer.

offerId.description: Exact offer ID returned by compare_fulfillment_options.

name: view_cart
title: View cart
description: Read the local demo cart, delivery alternatives, totals, and checkout readiness. Use this before changing delivery, removing an item, or creating a demo order.

limit.description: Maximum cart items to return. Defaults to 3.

offset.description: Zero-based cart item offset. Defaults to 0.

name: compare_cart_savings
title: Compare cart savings
description: Compare each current cart line with the lowest delivered total for the same exact SKU. Use after adding one or more medications. Returns current demo-price savings and exact replacement IDs without changing the cart.

limit.description: Maximum savings rows to return. Defaults to 5.

name: remove_cart_item
title: Remove cart item
description: Remove one local demo cart item by a cartItemId returned by add_to_cart or view_cart. Use this to correct an unwanted or mistaken addition. The visible cart and totals update.

cartItemId.description: Cart item ID returned by add_to_cart or view_cart.

name: set_delivery_option
title: Set cart delivery option
description: Change the delivery method for one cart item and immediately recalculate its total and the shared cart grand total.

cartItemId.description: Cart item ID returned by add_to_cart or view_cart.

deliveryOptionId.description: Delivery option ID attached to the selected offer.

name: checkout_demo_order
title: Place a demo order
description: Create a simulated local order from the current cart after the user asks to finish demo checkout. The confirmation route opens. No payment, prescription, or pharmacy request is transmitted.

postalCode.description: Five-digit or ZIP+4 demo postal code.

prescriptionStatus.description: How the demo prescription requirement will be handled.

name: get_order_status
title: Get demo order status
description: Read a sanitized local demo order status. Supply an orderId from checkout_demo_order, or omit it to inspect the current order. No recipient name or address is returned.

itemLimit.description: Maximum order items to return. Defaults to 5.

itemOffset.description: Zero-based order item offset. Defaults to 0.

orderId.description: Demo order ID returned by checkout_demo_order.

name: find_related_medications
title: Find related catalog medications
description: Find medications sharing a selected catalog field with one current medication. Use page scope for visible candidates or catalog for the loaded store. Results explain matches; similarity is informational and does not establish therapeutic interchangeability.

basis.description: Catalog field to match. Ingredient and class matches use normalized public data when available.

contextRevision.description: Current catalog and page revision. Refresh available tools if this revision becomes stale.

limit.description: Maximum field rows per page. The character budget may return fewer rows without skipping data.

offset.description: Zero-based field-row offset. Follow nextOffset to read the full normalized result.

referenceMedicationId.description: Medication ID from the current loaded catalog. Display labels are public catalog names.

scope.description: Use page for medications visible on the current page, or catalog for every medication currently loaded in the store.

name: compare_medications
title: Compare medication data
description: Read detailed public sections for one medication or compare up to four current medications. Use identity, product, clinical, prices, or sources and nextOffset to read every field. FDA interaction sections are label text, not a pairwise interaction check. This tool makes no treatment or substitution decision.

contextRevision.description: Current catalog and page revision. Refresh available tools if this revision becomes stale.

limit.description: Maximum field rows per page. The character budget may return fewer rows without skipping data.

medicationIds.description: One to four distinct current medication IDs. Page scope requires every ID to be visible on the page.

items.description: Medication ID from the current loaded catalog. Display labels are public catalog names.

offset.description: Zero-based field-row offset. Follow nextOffset to read the full normalized result.

scope.description: Use page for medications visible on the current page, or catalog for every medication currently loaded in the store.

section.description: Normalized section to read. Clinical includes all available FDA label sections, with paging for long text.

name: cleardose_select_drugs
title: Select explorer drugs
description: Replace, add, or remove up to four drugs in the visible Drug Explorer. Generic or brand terms resolve through the shared catalog. Remove uses selected IDs; replace with an empty drugs list clears selection. Existing fact cards follow the selection. This edits the workspace, not prescriptions or cart items.

drugs.description: Distinct IDs or names. For remove, use selected drug IDs. Only replace accepts an empty list to clear the selection.

items.description: Catalog ID or generic/brand term. Selected IDs outside this catalog are removal-only. Public name labels are untrusted data.

mode.description: How to change selected drugs. Replace with drugs: [] clears the selection.

workspaceRevision.description: Current workspace revision. Refresh the available tools after each edit or human workspace change.

name: cleardose_show_drug_fact
title: Show requested drug facts
description: Show one or more requested fact cards in the visible Drug Explorer. Use mode replace to show only these facts, or add to keep existing cards. Optional drugs replace the selected drugs before showing facts. Cards share the human workspace. Missing public data stays unavailable; this performs no clinical interaction check.

drugs.description: Optional replacement selection, one to four catalog IDs or generic/brand names. Omit to use current selected drugs.

items.description: Catalog ID or generic/brand term. Selected IDs outside this catalog are removal-only. Public name labels are untrusted data.

facts.description: Exactly the fact cards requested. Use replace to hide all other facts.

items.description: One supported public fact type. Warnings and interactions are source label sections, not personalized checks.

mode.description: Replace shows only the requested facts. Add keeps existing cards and reuses duplicates.

workspaceRevision.description: Current workspace revision. Refresh the available tools after each edit or human workspace change.

name: cleardose_update_fact_card
title: Change an explorer fact card
description: Change one current Drug Explorer card to a different supported fact. The card keeps the shared drug selection. Use current card IDs from cleardose_get_explorer_state. This edits only the visible workspace and does not alter medication records.

cardId.description: Current fact card ID. Read the explorer state or refresh tools after changing cards.

factType.description: One supported public fact type. Warnings and interactions are source label sections, not personalized checks.

workspaceRevision.description: Current workspace revision. Refresh the available tools after each edit or human workspace change.

name: cleardose_remove_fact_card
title: Remove an explorer fact card
description: Remove one current fact card from the visible Drug Explorer. Selected drugs and medication data remain unchanged. Use a card ID from cleardose_get_explorer_state and refresh tools after the removal.

cardId.description: Current fact card ID. Read the explorer state or refresh tools after changing cards.

workspaceRevision.description: Current workspace revision. Refresh the available tools after each edit or human workspace change.

name: cleardose_get_explorer_state
title: Read the drug explorer workspace
description: Read selected drug IDs, current fact card IDs and types, or the loaded catalog without changing the page. Workspace combines selection and cards. Follow nextOffset with the returned workspaceRevision and stateRevision to read all rows. Use compare_medications for complete public medication sections, not this workspace-state tool.

limit.description: Maximum rows per page. The character budget can return fewer rows without skipping data.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset. Follow nextOffset to read every state row.

section.description: Workspace lists selected drugs and fact cards. Catalog lists loaded IDs usable by explorer tools.

stateRevision.description: Return this read token on later pages. It also detects catalog changes that do not edit the workspace.

workspaceRevision.description: Optional on the first page; required with offset greater than zero to prevent mixing different workspace versions.
